name: sloprail-marketplace
description: Verifies the agent's claim against the real diff, not just that a rule fired. Guardrails for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, with a Stop gate.

plugins.name: sloprail-tasks
plugins.description: Guardrails for a memories/tasks/ workflow: a task's body must be the human's ask (cited, and nothing else), its evidence must resolve, its in_review claim is judged, and a turn may not end with open work. Four use-case guardrails in the nature format, shipped as a self-testing plugin. Requires the sloprail plugin (it installs the engine hooks).

plugins.name: sloprail-content
plugins.description: Guardrails for a memories/topics/<topic>/units/ content workflow: a unit's frontmatter taxonomy (channels, type, tags) selects which writing rules apply, script rules catch what LLMs are bad at (character limits, banned phrases), a judge weighs the rest, and a unit cannot reach status: published without a cited user approval and a published_url.
